safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports shortness of breath while running.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies SOB while running; generated facts do not mention exertional/running-related SOB.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting exertional shortness of breath (while running) can understate symptom triggers and severity, which may affect assessment of asthma control and the urgency of follow-up. This could delay appropriate escalation or safety-netting for activity-related bronchospasm.
